title: exceedance-design-effect: verification code for The Exceedance Design Effect
description: Verification code and the installable neff estimator for the paper "The Exceedance Design Effect: Effective Sample Size for Thresholds under Clustering" (arXiv:2608.21262). Each directory verifies one part of the argument; every script travels with its committed output so a reader can diff their run against ours.
